summary: Add HOME versus ADOPT placement to ticket intent

delivery.outcome: Ticket intents express HOME versus ADOPT placement with deterministic validation while existing intents remain compatible.
nonGoals: Do not require placement on existing tickets in the JSON Schema
Do not host a runtime service in wellmanifest
Do not publish a version tag or GitHub Release from the implementation branch
Do not merge without independent current-head trusted approval
Do not modify ticket-077 implementation or participant files

architecture.decision: Extend intent v2/v3 with one optional closed placement object and enforce HOME versus ADOPT invariants in the deterministic validator.
interfaceChanges: Add optional intent.placement to new-project.intent/v2 and v3
Add deterministic HOME versus ADOPT validation
dataChanges: New repository tickets may record home, shape, runtimeOwner and adopted Wellmanifest packs
architecture.rollback: Before merge, revert ticket-owned changes; after merge, preserve compatibility and publish a corrective patch rather than removing accepted placement fields.

commands: for suite in tests/*.test.sh; do bash $suite; done
